editorial.name: Paraform
editorial.descriptionZh: 招聘撮合平台：公司挂出关键岗位，平台把活派给 10k+ 独立招聘顾问，两边都配 AI agent 帮忙找人、触达和跟进。给招聘团队和独立猎头。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看招聘平台怎么把公司、猎头和 AI agent 三方写进同一屏
editorial.noteZh: 最顶一条浅蓝横幅写 Introducing Paraform Intelligence，下面是黑底首屏 Hire the future. Hire with conviction.，配一个 What's your work email? 的邮箱框和 Get started 按钮，左下角还浮着一个播放按钮，再往下压着 Trusted by 1,000+ world-class companies. 与 10k+ Expert recruiters 两行字。白底 logo 墙上是 Palantir、RIPPLING、DECAGON、ABRIDGE、Owner、scale、Basis。正文按 Companies 与 Recruiters 两条线分头写：公司侧讲 a hiring partner that understands exactly what you're looking for，顾问侧讲 Say goodbye to business development 和「Access an all-in-one AI toolkit with sourcing, candidate matching, CRM, notetaker, scheduler and more - completely free of charge.」，客户证言里 Grace Turner、Ben Katzburg、Anand Tumuluru 三条各带一句吐槽式引语。
editorial.pricing: unknown（公司侧未标价；招聘顾问侧工具免费）

reasons.statement: 页面把 Companies 与 Recruiters 拆成两条线，顾问一侧直接承诺 The world's largest expert recruiter network 和 We handle the business development, you focus on placing great talent，是撮合岗位与独立招聘顾问的双边市场，所以归招聘、人才与合作撮合。
不确定的地方：公司侧它自称 Agentic Hiring Platform 并给出一套 AI 工具，按工具归可以进 build-deploy-dev-workflow，但页面上用户最直接能拿到的是岗位与顾问之间的撮合，故取市场类。
